title: 全票加息25基点：利率升至3.75%-4%，点阵图显示还要再收紧？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It is a rate increase. The first of a cycle, a unanimous decision to raise their benchmark rate a quarter point to three and three quarters to four percent 16 members of the committee anticipate another increase this year
segments.zh: 这是本轮首次加息，委员会一致决定将基准利率上调25个基点至3.75%至4%。16位委员预计今年还将有一次加息。

segments.en: Only two would hold here Kevin wash the chairman does not submit a dot eight almost half see another increase another rate increase next year
segments.zh: 只有两人认为应维持利率不变。主席未提交点阵图。近半数委员预计明年还将加息一次。

segments.en: While six call for no change for see rate cuts in 2027 one of them calls for rates to fall to three and a quarter percent almost as significant
segments.zh: 六人预计利率不变，四人预计2027年降息，其中一人预计利率将降至3.25%。这一信号同样重要。

segments.en: They raised their long run view essentially the neutral rate to 3.2 percent from 3.1 percent in June the members see faster growth this year and next 2.3 and 2.4 percent up a 10th each from their June forecasts and the economic activity
segments.zh: 他们将长期中性利率预期从6月的3.1%上调至3.2%。委员们预计今明两年经济增长加快，分别为2.3%和2.4%，较6月预测各上调0.1个百分点。

segments.en: The statement says is expanding at a solid pace unemployment is forecast to remain at 4.1 percent this year and hold at that level through 2029
segments.zh: 声明称经济正以稳健步伐扩张。预计今年失业率维持在4.1%，并持续到2029年。

segments.en: Job gains the statement says have kept pace with the workforce and the unemployment rate has changed little inflation though according to the statement remains elevated
segments.zh: 声明称就业增长与劳动力保持同步，失业率变化不大。但通胀仍处高位。

segments.en: The median outlook is seen higher this year PCE headline at 3.7 percent up from 3.6 percent in June next year it falls to 2.3 percent achieving the 2 percent target gets pushed out as usual two years to 2029 now
segments.zh: 今年PCE通胀预期中值上调至3.7%，6月为3.6%。明年降至2.3%，实现2%目标的时间推迟两年至2029年。
